scope: Saved E4 span sensitivity, independent reporting arithmetic, and completion guards

Inventory ignored nested files named completion_seal.json; inventory now excludes only the root completion seal and explicit execution locks.
scientific_checks: Independent-arm bias and coverage MC uncertainty checked against hand calculations.
Log-RMSE-ratio uncertainty checked against squared-error variance calculations.
Unavailable intervals retain all planned coverage denominators.
Fixed-coefficient diagnostic MSE-minus-variance uncertainty retains per-path covariance.
Span support and weights remain outcome-independent, including invalid-point cases.
No or one valid-point fit within an eligible stratum does not fabricate point uncertainty.
Span verifier rejects settings changes, extra or missing exports, input changes, and edited arithmetic with self-consistent replacement file hashes.
limits: Standardization conditions on observed support, counts and weights; within-bin span and schedule differences remain.
Original versus standardized effect shrinkage is not a causal fraction explained by span.
This review does not certify full fixed-horizon experimental results or actual figure inspection.
